fields.label: Access Restriction
fields.help: Access restriction for the backup vault.

fields.label: Allow Missing
fields.help: Allow idempotent deletion of backup vault.

fields.label: Backup Retention Inheritance
fields.help: How a backup's enforced retention end time is inherited.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Force Update
fields.help: If set, allow update to extend the minimum enforced retention for backup vault.

fields.label: Force Update Access Restriction
fields.help: If set to true, we will force update access restriction even if some non compliant data sources are present.

fields.label: Ignore Backup Plan References
fields.help: If set, the following restrictions against deletion of the backup vault instance can be overridden: * deletion of a backup vault instance that is being referenced by an active backup plan.

fields.label: Ignore Inactive Datasources
fields.help: If set, the following restrictions against deletion of the backup vault instance can be overridden: * deletion of a backup vault instance containing no backups, but still containing empty datasources.

fields.label: Location
fields.help: The GCP location for the backup vault.

fields.label: Encryption Config
KMS Key Name
fields.help: The Resource name of the Cloud KMS key to be used to encrypt new backups.
Encryption configuration for the backup vault.
